shots.description: A loquat tree on a rooftop terrace with a white building with dark angled windows and a tower block behind, under a clear blue sky. The camera moves down past the leaves to show the terrace with planters and a glass balustrade.

Rooftop terrace garden at University College Hospital with small trees and shrubs in white planters, a glass balustrade and the building's angled roof panels behind, with a tower block in the distance on a clear day. The camera tracks sideways past a foreground tree branch to reveal the terrace.

Exterior of a white hospital building with green-tinted windows and sloped rooftop glazing, seen from a terrace garden with leafy trees and planting. The camera moves slowly forward towards the trees and facade under a clear blue sky.
Camera moves past a glass door frame onto a rooftop terrace with flowering rosemary in planters along a metal railing, with brick buildings and a tall chimney behind.

A flowering rosemary bush in a planter on a rooftop terrace behind a glass balustrade with metal rails, with brick buildings and a chimney in the background on a sunny day. A faint reflection of a person is visible in the glass on the right side of the frame.

Close-up of yellow daffodils growing in a flower bed outdoors, with green leaves in the foreground and a blurred street and greenery behind. The camera moves slowly along the flowers in spring sunshine.
Yellow daffodils and green leaves in the foreground, backlit by sunlight, with a blurred pale building and trees behind. A seasonal exterior cutaway with no people.

Close-up of purple grape hyacinths and ornamental grass in a stone planter outside the hospital, with a building and glass railings out of focus behind. The camera drifts slowly sideways past the flowers.

Low-angle close-up of purple grape hyacinths and dry ornamental grass in a planter outside University College Hospital, with the building and paving blurred in the background. The camera slides slowly sideways past the flowers.

Exterior courtyard garden outside a modern white building with angled glass windows, showing a curved stone bench with a wooden seat, shrubs and grasses, framed by overhanging leaves in the foreground. Sunny day with no people in shot.

Gimbal move across an empty rooftop terrace garden at University College Hospital, with small trees and plants in stone planters, curved bench seating and a glass balustrade, set against the building's windows and roofline solar panels in sunshine.
Low-angle view looking up at the roofline of the University College Hospital building, showing a rooftop railing and angled glazed panels against a clear blue sky as the camera pans across.

A staff member in a grey blazer with a name badge sits in an armchair by a skylight window, taking notes during a conversation with a woman seen from behind with long blonde hair. Appears to be a one-to-one consultation.

A consultant in a suit and name badge sits in an armchair taking notes on a pad while talking with a woman seen from behind, in a consulting room with a skylight window at University College Hospital.

A man in a grey blazer and name badge sits at a desk under a skylight, talking to a woman seen from behind in the foreground while holding a pen over paperwork on a clipboard. The camera slowly moves in during the conversation, which could be a meeting, interview or consultation.

A staff member in a grey blazer and name badge sits at a desk going through paperwork with pen in hand and talks with a colleague, who is seen out of focus over the shoulder in a room with a skylight. The shot suits one-to-one meeting, onboarding or careers content.

A consultant in a grey blazer and name badge sits at a desk under a skylight window, talking with a woman with long fair hair who faces away from camera. He holds a pen over paperwork, as if explaining next steps in a consultation.
A consultant in a grey blazer talks with a patient, seen from behind over her shoulder, then writes notes at a desk during a consultation in a room with a skylight window.
A man in a grey suit writes notes in an HCA ring binder open to an 'Allergen information' document at a wall-mounted desk, and the shot ends on his face in profile as he reads.
A man with a grey beard, wearing a grey blazer and open-collared shirt, sits beside a skylight window looking down, talking and smiling as if working at a desk or in conversation.
Close-up of a grey-bearded man in a grey blazer and open-collared shirt, looking down thoughtfully in a room lit by a skylight window, then turning away from camera.
A woman with long blonde hair in a white blouse sits by a skylight window and looks away from camera, then glances down in a quiet, reflective moment, as if during or between interview answers.
A woman in a white blouse speaks during a seated interview in a room with a skylight, then turns and looks thoughtfully towards the window.
A woman with blonde hair sits at a desk under skylight windows, talking and gesturing during an interview, then turns pages in a folder of documents.
A woman with blonde hair sits at a wooden desk under a skylight, reading from an open document folder and speaking. The camera moves around her from the desk to a profile view of her face.

Close-up of a staff member in a dark suit and tie wearing a name badge that reads Richard, Head of Catering and Nutritional Services, at University College Hospital. The camera holds on the badge as he stands with his arm resting on a surface.

shots.description: Slow push-in on a made hospital bed in a patient room with skylight windows, with folded white towels, a rolled towel, a row of toiletry bottles and an HCA welcome card placed at the head of the bed.
shots.text_on_screen: HCA logo on welcome card (remaining text not legible)

shots.description: Folded white towels topped with a set of toiletry tubes, a wooden box and an HCA welcome card, laid out on a hospital bed in a patient room by the window at University College Hospital.

A staff member in blue scrubs walks into a private patient room at University College Hospital, gestures towards the wall-mounted TV and wooden storage units, then turns and talks while showing the room's features.

A staff member in a light blue uniform with a name badge stands in a private patient room at University College Hospital, gesturing around the room as he explains it. Folded towels and toiletries are laid out on the made-up bed, with a skylight window, wardrobe and wall-mounted TV visible.

A staff member in a blue tunic uses a handset remote to adjust a made-up hospital bed in a patient room with skylight windows, then the camera moves up to show his face as he looks down at the controls.

A female patient in a hospital gown sits propped up on pillows in bed in a patient room, smiling as she looks to the side, then turns her head and closes her eyes, appearing relaxed. A window and bedside cabinet are visible in the background.
A female patient in a hospital gown sits up in bed in a patient room, looking out towards the window. The camera rises from her hands resting on the sheet to her face in profile.
A woman in a hospital gown sits up in bed in a patient room, talking to someone off camera in an interview-style shot, with a window and bedside cabinet behind her.

A nurse in a blue tunic attends to a smiling female patient in a hospital gown, who sits up and chats in a patient room. The nurse is out of focus in the foreground and blocks the frame at the start of the shot.
A staff member's hand passes a nurse call handset to a female patient sitting up in a hospital bed in a patient room. She looks at it, smiles and raises her hand as she responds.
A nurse in a blue tunic shows a female patient in a hospital gown how to use the TV remote in her private patient room, then points across the room as she watches from the bed.

A male nurse in a blue tunic stands beside a female patient in a hospital gown in a private room and shows her how to use a handheld bed control. The patient sits up by the window, smiling and talking with him.

A staff member in a blue tunic stands beside a patient in a hospital gown sitting up in bed and shows her how to use a handheld remote. She then takes the remote and points it across the room, smiling.

A nurse in a blue tunic adjusts the pillows behind a woman in a hospital gown sitting up in bed in a private patient room, then leans in to talk with her. A TV remote rests on the overbed table beside her.
A staff member in blue uniform hands a bed control handset to a female patient in a hospital gown sitting up in bed in a private patient room. The patient takes it and talks to the staff member.

Close-up of a person's hands pressing the pump on a red hand sanitiser bottle mounted on a hospital bed rail, then rubbing their hands together. The background is an out-of-focus room with a sofa and window.
Close-up of a hand-sanitiser pump bottle clipped to a white bed rail as a person dispenses gel and rubs their hands together, with a sofa and window out of focus behind.
Close-up of a staff member in a blue top rubbing their hands together after using a red hand sanitiser dispenser mounted on a rail. Armchairs and windows are out of focus in the background.

A hospitality staff member in a white shirt and dark waistcoat walks through a doorway carrying a tray with a bottle of water and a glass, then passes close to the camera on her way to a patient room.

A patient in a hospital gown sits in her room smiling as a member of hospitality staff brings over a tray with a bottle of water and a glass and sets it on the over-bed table. The two share a friendly exchange.

A smiling patient in a hospital gown sits up in bed in a private room while a staff member in a waistcoat uniform brings in a tray with a bottle of water and sets it down for her. The two chat and laugh during the visit.

A hospitality staff member in a waistcoat uniform opens a bottle of water and pours a glass for a female patient in a hospital gown, and the two chat and laugh in a patient room at University College Hospital.

A patient in a hospital gown sits up in bed in a private room while a male nurse in a blue tunic hands her a small medicine cup from a blue tray during a medication round. She takes the cup and holds it, with a water bottle and glass on the overbed table.

A nurse holding a blue tray hands medication to a patient sitting up in a hospital bed, who takes it with a glass of water in a private patient room. They talk, and the patient smiles as he turns to leave.

A patient in a hospital gown sits up in bed in a private patient room, smiling and talking with a staff member who appears in the foreground holding a blue folder. An overbed table with a water bottle and glass is in front of her.

A female patient in a hospital gown sits up in bed in a private patient room, drinks a glass of water and places it back on a tray on the overbed table, next to a bottle of water and a small cup. A blue tray is out of focus in the foreground.
A nurse in blue HCA scrubs holding a blue tray talks to a patient and hands her a small medicine cup in a patient room at University College Hospital. The patient is seen from behind.

A nurse in a blue HCA tunic hands a small medicine cup from a blue tray to a patient sitting in a hospital patient room, then smiles and talks with them. This is a bedside medication round at University College Hospital.

A male staff member in a light blue HCA tunic with a name badge talks while working in a patient room at University College Hospital, then picks up a blue tray. Wooden wardrobe units, a sink and wall-mounted hand sanitiser dispensers are visible behind him.
A staff member in a dark uniform places a tray holding a white teapot and milk jug on an over-bed table in a patient room, then steps away. Low-angle shot of tea service in front of a bright window.

shots.description: A female patient in a hospital gown sits in her patient room at University College Hospital. She looks down, then turns towards the camera and smiles while talking.

Two staff in scrubs, aprons and blue cryogenic gloves open a liquid nitrogen dry shipper and lift out a frozen container as vapour rises, likely to thaw stored cells such as stem cells, beside a computer trolley in a hospital room.

A staff member wearing blue cryogenic gloves lifts the lid of a liquid nitrogen dewar strapped to a stand, then the shot moves to a grey-haired clinician in blue scrubs and an apron leaning over to work, with a colleague in the background. This appears to be the handling of cryopreserved cells, such as for a stem cell infusion.

A staff member wearing blue cryogenic gloves and a plastic apron removes the lid from a liquid nitrogen storage dewar, and cold vapour rises from the opening. Cryogenic sample storage in a hospital lab.

In a patient room at University College Hospital, a staff member in an apron and gloves brings a blue tray and folder to a woman in a hospital bed. A nurse in a navy uniform joins him, holding a blue folder.

A patient in a hospital gown sits up in bed in a private patient room as a staff member in a plastic apron and blue gloves brings in a blue tray. A nurse joins him and checks a blue folder while the patient looks on.

Two nurses in blue uniforms, disposable aprons and gloves stand together in a patient room, one holding a blue tray while the other looks at a blue clipboard. They appear to be checking items or notes together before giving care.

Two nurses in gloves and aprons hold blue medication trays and check details on a computer screen showing an electronic patient record, likely in a patient room. The camera moves in from a wide view to a closer shot of them talking through the check.

Two staff in disposable aprons and blue gloves stand at a stainless steel sink in a clinical utility area, where one hands the other paperwork and a small item. The man is in the foreground with his back partly to camera, and the woman faces the lens.

A staff member in blue nitrile gloves places a sealed plastic-wrapped item into a stainless steel sink while a colleague in a navy uniform and disposable apron stands in the background. The scene appears to show cleaning or decontamination work in a clinical utility area.

Close-up of an older male patient with short grey hair, wearing a blue hospital gown with a disposable plastic apron over his shoulders, sitting quietly and looking down in a patient room at University College Hospital. A wooden door and a wall-mounted sink and dispensers are out of focus behind him.
Nurses in HCA uniforms hold a handover or team huddle at a nurses' station, two listening with folders and notes while a colleague in the foreground speaks and holds papers.
Nurses in HCA uniforms hold a handover at a ward nurses' station, reviewing printed handover sheets and talking together. Computer workstations are visible behind them.

Nurses in HCA uniforms hold a shift handover or team huddle at a ward nurses' station, with two nurses speaking while holding paperwork as colleagues in the foreground listen with their backs to camera.
Two nurses in HCA uniforms stand at a ward nurses' station holding notebooks and talk with colleagues who hold paperwork, in what looks like a shift handover or team briefing.

Two nurses at a nurses' station hold paperwork and smile as they talk with two colleagues in the foreground, who are seen from behind, during what looks like a shift handover. One nurse writes notes on a form at the counter.
Two nurses in HCA Healthcare uniforms hold a handover or briefing at a nurses' station. One writes on paperwork while she talks to colleagues, who stand out of focus in the foreground holding papers.

Close-up of a wall-mounted world map with coloured pins marking locations across the Americas, Europe, Africa and the Middle East, as the camera moves across from the Americas towards Europe and Africa.

Close-up of a wall graphic at University College Hospital showing the HCA Healthcare UK logo and a world map. The camera moves across to a banner reading 'One team, many cultures', highlighting the diversity of the staff.

shots.description: A receptionist with grey hair smiles at the camera from behind the front desk at University College Hospital, then the camera moves right to show a woman reading a magazine in an armchair in the waiting area beside a sofa and a leaflet stand.

An outdoor roof terrace with a glass-panel floor, wooden tables and chairs, closed green parasols and planters, where a few people sit and talk. The camera tilts up from the floor past the seating to the rooftop railings and blue sky.

An empty outdoor roof terrace at University College Hospital with wooden tables and chairs, closed green parasols and a glass-panel floor, with planters along the balcony above. The camera moves slowly to the right across the seating area in sunlight.

An empty outdoor courtyard terrace at University College Hospital with wooden tables and chairs, closed green parasols and a glass-panel floor, overlooked by a balcony lined with planters. The camera moves back and across to reveal the full seating area and glass doors.

Empty outdoor courtyard terrace at University College Hospital with wooden tables and chairs, closed green parasols and a glass-panelled floor, overlooked by planted balconies. The camera moves slowly across the seating area in daylight.
An empty, lit hospital corridor with doors along one wall and a potted plant beside a glass window looking out onto an outdoor courtyard. The camera drifts slowly along the corridor.
An empty hospital corridor at University College Hospital, with doors and framed pictures along one wall and windows with blinds along the other, as the camera moves slowly down the corridor.

Low-angle moving shot along an empty hospital corridor at University College Hospital, with wall lights, framed artwork, concrete pillars and windows with blinds, travelling toward doors at the far end.

A tracking shot along a wooden leaflet rack holding Macmillan Cancer Support information booklets, including titles on work and cancer, eating problems and cancer, and the emotional effects of cancer.
